caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a detailed backrest featuring a shield shape and ornate, symmetrical curved designs in the splat. The wood is colored in shades of brown, with darker and lighter tones giving it a natural, polished appearance. The seat is upholstered, covered with a deep purple fabric, and is bordered with a decorative trim that appears to be greenish-yellow in color and follows a scalloped pattern along the edge. The chair has four straight, tapered legs, with horizontal bars connecting them for support. The background is plain and off-white, and there is no other object present except for the printed name "ALFRED NASON" in the lower right corner.
title: Side Chair (one of six)
